import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":55001,\"payment_application_markup_line_item\":{\"work_completed_this_period\":\"1000.00\",\"work_completed_retainage_retained_this_period\":\"100.00\",\"work_completed_retainage_released_this_period\":\"0.00\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/prime_contracts/%7Bprime_contract_id%7D/payment_application_markup_line_items/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
